description: This file declares classes, structs, and functions related to building and verifying certificate paths in a public key infrastructure (PKI). It includes definitions for CertPathBuilder, CertPathBuilderDelegate, and CertPathBuilderResultPath, among others, used for certificate chain validation and path construction.

classes.name: CertPathBuilderDelegateData
classes.description: Base class for custom data that can be attached to certificate paths during path building.

classes.name: CertPathBuilderResultPath
classes.description: Represents a candidate certificate path, indicating whether it is valid, trusted, and associated errors.

classes.name: CertPathBuilderDelegate
classes.description: Interface for controlling policies during certificate verification and path building.

classes.name: CertPathBuilder
classes.description: Main class for constructing and verifying certificate paths to trust anchors.

methods.name: CheckPathAfterVerification
methods.description: Called after RFC 5280 verification to allow delegate to reject or accept candidate paths.

methods.name: IsDeadlineExpired
methods.description: Checks if the path building process should be terminated due to deadline.

methods.name: HasValidPath
methods.description: Indicates if a valid certificate path was found.

methods.name: AnyPathContainsError
methods.description: Checks if any attempted path contains a specific error.

methods.name: GetBestValidPath
methods.description: Returns the best valid certificate path found.

methods.name: GetBestPathPossiblyInvalid
methods.description: Returns the best certificate path, even if invalid.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the certificate path building and verification process.
